**[P2] Preserve containment when every clock sample is interrupted**

The midpoint retains up to half the sampling window plus `Date.now()` truncation as epoch error. The new all-stalled fixtures observe a ±5 ms offset and explicitly skip user-span containment assertions, so a scheduler or GC pause can still place user spans outside their SDK parents. Retain the bracket endpoints and use the earliest valid boundary for starts and latest valid boundary for ends in both plugins, then assert containment for the stalled fixtures.
